tokens.name: fjb-blue
tokens.usage: Logo blue, sampled from the master logo. Solid fields, the primary colour of the brand. White text reads on it at 6.1:1.

tokens.name: fjb-orange
tokens.usage: Logo orange, sampled from the master logo. Fills and marks only. Takes `midnight` text, never white.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Lightened logo blue for dark grounds, taken from the highlights of the dark logo render. Used for the logo, links and fills on `midnight`.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Deep navy ground for dark sections, and the ink for one-colour print on light grounds.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Fixed white for print and stationery. Stays white in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Carries `ink`, `ink-muted`, `primary` and `accent-text`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on `surface`. Carries `ink`, `ink-muted`, `primary` and `accent-text`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks and table headers. Carries `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and captions on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links and selected states on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` or `primary-hover` fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Highlights: the one call to action on a page, key numbers behind `on-accent`, rules and crescents.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` or `accent-hover` fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange when it has to be small text, on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control outlines. Holds 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px solid with a 2px offset. Holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always paired with an icon and a word.
